designDecisionsAndRationale: RC2/R1-R2: textCells cluster ranges become run-relative (offsetInRun(...) - run.from, clamped at 0), because the absolute offset skipped the first N characters of any line starting at document offset N.
RC1/R3-R4: the atlas cache key includes the rasterized texel width and subpixel phase, because the 40 px gutter-label '1' cell was reused for the document '1'.

RC3/R5: non-text instances carry identity slot 0 and the text slot is reset after each segment/gutter build, because currentSlot leaked a line offset into caret, underline, selection and backdrop layers.

RC5/R6-R9: glyph quads map 1:1 to device pixels (4-phase raster, exact cell/scale size, SNAP_GLYPH vertex snap via u_device, NEAREST filtering); 4 phases match Chromium/Skia subpixel positioning and keep monospace spacing even.

RC4/R10-R11: the fragment shader emits premultiplied color under the existing ONE, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA blend; upload stays straight alpha; hard-coded translucent literals are converted to straight alpha so their composite is unchanged.
RC6/R12: the visuals context requests webgl2 with antialias:false; blit rectangles and formats already match, so the blit itself is unchanged.
Font: keep the system monospace stack at weight 400 with no bundled font unless the owner answers CR1/CR2 otherwise; any bundled font requires its license file and notice.
intentionalTradeoffs: Four quantized subpixel phases instead of continuous positioning: up to 4 atlas cells per glyph in exchange for crisp, evenly spaced text.
NEAREST filtering: near-1:1 rather than exact mapping when DPR is budget-reduced, accepted over LINEAR blur.
Seams between complex-script run pieces may differ by up to 0.25 device px (path out of scope).
Pixel-test thresholds P3 (at most 2 device px) and P4 (ratio within [0.7, 1.4]) may be calibrated once in CR-07 within the CR-06 rule, and the calibration is recorded.
An unavailable SwiftShader backend makes code-pixels.mjs exit 2 (blocked), never a pass.
supportedEdgeCases: Lines starting at non-zero document offsets, short lines whose length is below their offset, and partially visible runs (visibleFrom inside a run).
The same cluster text at different widths (gutter labels vs document text) and at different phases.
Multi-style syntax-colored runs, chunked runs (256-cluster chunks) and tabs splitting runs.
Fractional scroll and the floor in effectiveSize absorbed by the u_device uniform; DPR 1 and 2; budget-reduced DPR.
Caret, diagnostic/composition/call-head underlines, selection, playing/eval highlights and backdrop after multi-line edits.
Completion popup open while typing; ANGLE Metal and SwiftShader backends; WebGL error console scanned.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Complex-script and emoji shaping quality beyond the shared key/placement rules.
Gamma, contrast, LCD subpixel AA and font-weight tuning (CR2).
